candidate: Overlap selected-tab module loading and fresh authorized initial GET for Members, Applicants, Tasks and Announcements.
scope: Application code and disposable local measurement only.
security: Fresh original GET authorization per visit; no authorization cache.
No protected stale-data reveal while initial validation is pending.
Fence previous navigation and authority results; preserve mutations and Demo adapters.
No production infrastructure, database, schema or index changes.

measurement.inputMethod: Keyboard activation, consistently in both builds; pointer/touch covered separately by acceptance checks.
measurement.sameBuildControl: The middle AA pair is analyzed separately; no source changes.
measurement.firstTwoPilotFailures: Obsolete club-label selector and pointer flyout adapter; retained, excluded from the registered keyboard comparison. The third pilot passes all eight cases.

decision: Keep only demonstrated improvements; report warm/security and payload tradeoffs explicitly.
release: Reviewable branch; Phase 1 merge authorization applied to that branch.

analysis.percentiles: Nearest rank, same function as existing navigation harness.
analysis.primary: All four BA/AB pairs pooled; the middle AA pair and all warmups remain separate.
analysis.intervals: 10,000 fixed-seed resamples of four whole matched blocks; descriptive intervals, not production inference.
analysis.failurePolicy: Preserve all rows and failures. A missing planned observation, browser/HTTP error, or missing workspace body counter stops acceptance. No retries or outlier removal.
analysis.initialCodeCost: Also record all script body bytes loaded before each measured click; cold values include initial source-page JS.
